instruction: Please help me install the GitLens extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the GitLens extension (eamodio.gitlens) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies the extension is installed by checking the output of 'code --list-extensions' command.
metadata.verification: Verified that is_extension_installed metric with 'contain' type check will correctly identify if the extension ID appears in the command output.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: 'code --list-extensions' command correctly lists all installed VS Code extensions, returns stdout
Metric logic is correct: is_extension_installed checks if 'eamodio.gitlens' appears in the output using 'contain' type comparison
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: accesses rules['type'] and rules['expected'] directly (correct for type='rule')
Expected value is correct: 'eamodio.gitlens' is the official extension ID for GitLens
Coverage is complete: evaluator verifies the only requirement in the instruction (GitLens extension installed)
Runtime feasibility verified: command works without shell, substring search will correctly detect extension ID in multiline output
No pipe operator issues: command is simple array without shell operators
